description:
Decibel data, free, no registration. series:
        "vault" = the Decibel Protocol Vault (DLP, the exchange's market maker) right now: TVL,
        PnL, fee income and its position on every market;
        "exchange_daily" = Decibel's daily volume, fees and open interest, last 30 days (the
        same numbers as Decibel's own API).
        The recorded history of funding, open interest, mark, the vault's positions and TVL is
        not downloadable: Pitbi uses it only inside tests (the sandbox and the Lab: the last 7
        days free, everything after registration). Every answer says when the data is from.
        Data, not advice.
name: decibel_data
